item.title: Miley Cyrus to Receive Star on Hollywood Walk of Fame
item.description:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host's energetic voice takes over]
Host: "Hey there, music lovers. Welcome to this week's trending news on Billboard. We've got some exciting news to share with you today. Miley Cyrus is getting her very own star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
[Short music transition]
Host: "On May 22nd, Miley will be honored with the 2,845th star, located at 7011 Hollywood Blvd. And it's going to be a star-studded ceremony, with Anya Taylor-Joy and Donatella Versace speaking, and Ellen K as the emcee. You can catch the ceremony live on the Walk of Fame website at 11:30 am PT.
[Short music transition]
Host: "Miley's had an incredible career, with two No. 1 hits on the Billboard Hot 100 - 'Wrecking Ball' and 'Flowers'. She's won three Grammys, and had four No. 1 albums on the Billboard 200. She's also had notable performances in films and TV shows like 'Black Mirror', and has been a part of major campaigns for top brands like Gucci and Dolce & Gabbana.
[Short music transition]
Host: "But what's really inspiring is Miley's philanthropic work. She's the founder of the Happy Hippie Foundation and the Miley Cyrus Foundation, supporting LGBTQ+ youth and mothers in all their diversity. As Walk of Fame producer Ana Martinez said, 'Miley deserves her flowers' for making a lasting impact on the entertainment industry.
[Short music transition]
Host: "So, mark your calendars for May 22nd, and tune in to the ceremony to celebrate Miley's well-deserved star. That's all for today, folks. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one."
[Outro music starts playing]
